verdict.rationale: Amplitude documents an API to export project event data, cohort export, a Dashboard REST API that returns chart data as JSON, and a taxonomy API that can read event types and properties. Together these cover the core data-extraction paths. However, only the dashboard data is explicitly stated to be in an open format (JSON). The raw event export format is unspecified, and nothing covers exporting session replays or other assets, or offboarding and account deletion. The listed warehouse integrations (BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks) don't state whether they are export destinations. Missing for 10: documented open format for the raw event export, evidence that all data types (replays, experiments, guides) can be exported, a documented offboarding/deletion path, warehouse export direction confirmed, independent hands-on corroboration.
